rationale: Learner elected MCQ format in place of summary. Scored 5/8 with one partial and two blanks. Learner elected to advance despite Partial.
evidence: Q1 correct: @tool raises ValueError at decoration time when docstring missing — decorator-contract internalized.
Q2 correct: required list = params without defaults — correctly mapped signature rules to JSON schema output.
Q5 correct (despite self-reported uncertainty): identified that await on a sync function raises TypeError — confirms the reason for the iscoroutinefunction branch.
Q6 correct: only @tool-decorated callables carry __tool_spec__; module-level constants and private helpers are filtered by hasattr sweep.
Q3 incorrect: Parameter.empty conflated with runtime None — missed that it is a distinct sentinel class used by inspect to mean 'absent', which is why None can still be a legitimate default.
Q4 partial: named B correctly but also selected A (deprecation) which has no basis in the registry code.
Q7 blank: str(result) vs json.dumps(result) distinction unprobed — the LLM receives Python's single-quoted dict repr, not valid JSON. Handlers must pre-serialize if they want clean JSON.
Q8 blank: exception-to-ToolResultBlock(is_error=True) conversion unprobed — directly resolves the ch-02 carryforward gap on tool-handler exception flow (loop continues, not bails).
gaps: Parameter.empty sentinel semantics — distinguishing 'absent declaration' from 'runtime None'.
str(result) boundary: LLM sees Python repr, not JSON — handlers must pre-serialize if they want valid JSON.
ToolExecutor exception handling: errors become ToolResultBlock(is_error=True) data, loop continues — this was a ch-02 carryforward that MCQ surfaced but did not self-resolve.
